-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.InvRestore` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def mvcc.idxRestore (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) : mvcc.IndexM :=
  List.foldl mvcc.idxRestoreEnt [] ents

def mvcc.revKeyValue_countable : Pos.Countable go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.revKeyValue :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective (fun r => Pos.Countable.encode (r.key', r.kv', r.kstr')) ⋯

def mvcc.revProt (ti : Loc) (Tok : IProp GF) (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) (i : Int) (v : w64) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(⌜i = 0 ∧ v = mvcc.restoreLastRev ents⌝ ∗
      Tok ∗ ⧗ents.length ∗ ∃ L, mvcc.ownIdxPriv ti L ∗ ⌜mvcc.idxOfEntries L = mvcc.idxRestore ents⌝)

def mvcc.RestoreEntsOk (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise (fun a b => a.rev.lt b.rev) ents ∧
    ∀ (e : mvcc.KvEnt), e ∈ ents → 1 ≤ sint.Z e.rev.main ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z e.rev.sub

def mvcc.rkvProt (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) (i : Int) (rkv :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.revKeyValue) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ e, ⌜ents[i.toNat]? = some e ∧ 0 ≤ i⌝ ∗ mvcc.rkvIs Rd rkv e)

def mvcc.kvMsgOf (st : google_golang_org.protobuf.internal.impl.MessageState) (ks vs uf : GoSlice)
    (sc : w32) (kv : EtcdKv) : go_etcd_io.etcd.api.v3.mvccpb.KeyValue :=
  { state' := st, Key' := ks, CreateRevision' := kv.createRev, ModRevision' := kv.modRev, Version' := kv.version,
    Value' := vs, Lease' := kv.lease, unknownFields' := uf, sizeCache' := sc }

def mvcc.idxRestoreEnt (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (e : mvcc.KvEnt) : mvcc.IndexM :=
  match mvcc.idxGet idx e.kv.key with
  | some ki =>
    if e.tomb = true then
      if mvcc.kiLastEmpty ki = true then idx else btInsert mvcc.idxLess (e.kv.key, mvcc.kiTombstone ki e.rev) idx
    else btInsert mvcc.idxLess (e.kv.key, mvcc.kiPut ki e.rev) idx
  | none =>
    btInsert mvcc.idxLess
      (e.kv.key,
        if e.tomb = true then mvcc.kiRestoreTombstone e.rev else mvcc.kiRestore e.kv.createRev e.rev e.kv.version)
      idx

def mvcc.restoreLastRev (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) : w64 :=
  match ents.getLast? with
  | some e => e.rev.main
  | none => W64 1

def mvcc.rkvIs (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (rkv :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.revKeyValue) (e : mvcc.KvEnt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ Rd rkv.key' (mvcc.revBytes e.rev e.tomb) ∗
      ⌜rkv.kstr' = e.kv.key⌝ ∗
        ∃ ks vs uf st sc,
          typedPointsto rkv.kv' (mvcc.kvMsgOf st ks vs uf sc e.kv) (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            ownSlice ks e.kv.key DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice vs e.kv.value DFrac.discard)
